owner_decisions.windows_distribution: Online installation is sufficient. A standalone offline installer is outside the selected support scope.

published_baseline.reason: The published Windows IDE reserved an approved catalog revision. Run remained disabled on that reservation and the published client had no native launch method.

services.observation: The installed public client launched the native root on the current worker. In the three-node KinD cohort ten native Jobs overlapped for 11.715489 s and twenty authenticated observers saw every completion. One of 100 separate native starts won; 99 returned conflict. Individual receipts identify the cluster and source.
services.remaining: Complete the outstanding Listener partition, multi-Context isolation and concurrent alias/version cases on the supported deployment.

native_family.observation: Short original sanitizer checks passed. The completed five-minute controller and installed-IDE runs grew 259.07 and 308.17 MiB against 64 MiB. The comparable optimized runs grew 3.46 and 3.36 MiB. The final single-host root and child completed after three witnessed control transfers or reconnections. Both original hours were skipped when their prerequisites failed.
native_family.remaining: Correct the original five-minute memory failures, then run both mandatory one-hour scenarios. The original growth, peak, cgroup and swap limits still apply.

compatibility.observation: 318 of 763 inherited IDs passed all four dimensions across source-identified native runs. 27 have a reproduced failing mandatory positive dependency. 418 lack a complete native verdict. All recovered historical capture and source references remain independently verifiable.
compatibility.remaining: Correct the reproduced adapter behaviors and finish the four inherited dimensions for the remaining IDs. Rerun affected rows on the intended delivery pair.
command_or_ci_run: Original source cases and retained native roots in the three indexed compatibility archives

driver_faults.observation: A causal before/after on independent GENERIC produced 80/80 original telemetry and 8/8 command assertions, including four commands with twenty ordered binary acknowledgments. An explicitly bounded native operation succeeded and the over-limit inputs remained denied. Hosted two- and three-second bursts still have retained failures; one measured 1,214.5 ms of ledger waiting overlapping 1,191.5 ms of durable sync.
driver_faults.remaining: Demonstrate reliable original deadlines and complete deployed TC/ack/TM, recovery, isolation and uncertain-outcome oracles on the delivered driver and independent DSS.

ide_browser.observation: On the frozen delivery pair, the original native root and child remained paused across explicit A to B to A handoffs and reconnect. Twenty additional Chromium observers saw FINISHED. B answered the original question once and stale controller and observer commands returned 403. Both vendor-host processes loaded the verified JetBrains ZIP.
ide_browser.remaining: The user must complete JetBrains onboarding in IntelliJ IDEA and PyCharm so the project-level Run and Debug checks can run. Remaining browser request/reject/expiry and multi-panel contracts need complete coverage.

compose.observation: The real five-service deployment is covered by versioned hosted tests. Separate local Compose recovery preserved fifteen pre-checkpoint audit rows and the original ASRUN across upgrade, restoration into a fresh volume, rollback and re-upgrade. Authenticated stale worker and controller requests were rejected.
compose.remaining: Finish the independent DSS and worker-loss, egress and survival matrix on the delivered Compose topology.
command_or_ci_run: Exact Compose commands and revisions in compose-recovery.json and compose-active-storage-fault.json

kubernetes.observation: The local enforcing three-node KinD cluster admitted one of 100 full native requests. Ten Jobs finished across two worker nodes. A new authority on the same PVC retained the paused root in RECOVERY_REQUIRED after the original authority and worker were independently fenced. Calico policy decisions and actual node-runtime observations are recorded.
kubernetes.remaining: Provide the representative cluster and its operator. Complete node partition/drain, admission, storage recovery, upgrade and rollback against that deployment.
command_or_ci_run: cluster.py, deploy.py, run.py, single.py, fence.py and verify_template.py

recovery.observation: Compose rollback and roll-forward retained all 15 original durable events and ASRUN. A running Context failed closed on disk exhaustion. KinD separately preserved all 11 pre-loss events for the original paused root and denied the superseded controller proof after fencing.
recovery.remaining: Complete representative multi-node storage restoration, authority fencing and independent DSS uncertain-effect recovery on the target deployment.

security.observation: Exact runtime images each have a CycloneDX inventory, advisory/package matches and installed notices. Six package pairs have matching declared license bytes. The Debian desktop retains a scanner-critical libxml2 finding. Supplier versions, local evidence and outstanding review appear together.
security.remaining: An independent reviewer must assess the implemented system and the exposure of outstanding advisories. The release owner must explicitly decide any proposed risk exceptions.
command_or_ci_run: Pinned Trivy image inventory and vulnerability scanner

The original sanitizer and deadline failures remain mandatory inputs. The separate close-child terminal run on 4a recorded a kernel OOM at its 768 MiB fixture limit.
ci.remaining: Require all mandatory jobs and supported integration surfaces on the identified delivery pair within their original limits.

packaging.observation: Windows installed the exact IDE wheel, passed ordinary Run/Debug with SPELL absent, then installed the four 0.8.0 runtime wheels and the 0.1.0 simulator SDK. All six products matched their installed wheel bytes, seven third-party wheels were downloaded online, and the Debian desktop passed X11 Run/Debug and Chromium/noVNC.
